tasks: Do 3 open-world activities held by Black Tusk: control points, hostage rescues, public executions, broadcasts or convoys.
Finish 1 Invaded Mission. Any main mission where Black Tusk have taken over counts.
Kill Eagle Eye, the Black Tusk bounty in West End. Take out his drones first.
finale: Take down Bobby Guzmán, the Cleaners boss, at Washington National Airport. Fast travel from the Manhunt tab.
ended: That's Red Horizon finished. The next season has no start date yet.
